title.narrative: Support Development and Implementation of Ethical AI Governance Frameworks

description.narrative: This activity provides coordinated technical and programmatic support to advance artificial intelligence governance frameworks including development of AI strategies, and policies, and strengthening institutions to implement same, in Member States in Southern Africa. Interventions under this activity will therefore focus on two specific areas of action. First, the activity will support the development of national policies and strategies in countries that have already successfully concluded the Readiness Assessment Methodology (RAM) exercises (Zimbabwe, Malawi, Botswana and Namibia), as part of the six-country pilot exercise initiated in the region in the 42 C/5, and accelerate the process of completion for countries that are yet to conclude their RAMs (Malawi). The second action will support implementation of the new and emerging policies and strategies, with a specific focus of capacity building and strengthening national institutions designed/created to drive successful implementation of these policies. Collectively, these interventions will promote ethical, inclusive, and well-coordinated AI ecosystems while strengthening national institutional readiness and regional policy coherence.
